name: Footing Blow
description: Strike with a blow that comes up from the foundation of the frame and carries the weight of a hill.

name: Column Stance
description: Stand with the frame set as a single pillar that carries any blow down into the earth.

name: Keel Lance
description: Drive a lance of keel bone through a guard and out the far side of the target.

name: Fused Sweep
description: Swing a great beam of fused bone across the field and sweep every foe aside.

name: Foundation Break
description: Break the very foundation of a foe's frame so the whole body fails beneath all guard.

name: Unmoved Frame
description: Stand unmoved while the force of a mighty blow is drawn into the bone and spent there.

name: Ageless Marrow
description: Pour ageless marrow qi into an ally's frame to close old breaks and refill worn bone.

name: Skeleton Step
description: Pass from one stance to another in a blink with the frame shifting as one piece.

name: Last Framework
description: The canon's stroke that raises the whole framework round a foe and drives its points inward at once.

name: Lasting Pillar
description: The canon's pillar that bears all weight upon itself and presses every foe's will beneath it.

name: Foundation Fall
description: Bring the whole foundation of the frame down on every foe in reach up to the ceiling of the tier.

name: Persistent Frame
description: Let the frame persist through its own undoing so a blow that should break it finds nothing to break.
